scope: All 18 configured store/evidence destinations checked; 12 public feeds reconciled. Feed URL identity and saved variant differences checked, not a manual visual or authenticity audit of every product. No all-China completeness claim.

stores.name: KikaGoods
stores.finding: 613 of 616 saved URLs matched the feed; one renamed Honkai page redirects correctly and two return 404. New toy candidates include Great Power Fortune Cat and MayMei Greedy Bear. Acrylic badges, coasters and cards need separate scope review.

stores.name: TOP TOY international store
stores.finding: 243 of 245 saved URLs matched; two return 404. Nommi Christmas Forest Feast and both Zootopia releases are already captured. Piropiroo is a new candidate; two Nommi crossbody bags are intentionally outside toy counts. Christmas Forest Feast single-box asking price is now USD 29.99, with availability not yet enabled.

stores.name: 52TOYS international store
stores.finding: All 96 saved URLs matched the 199-record feed; no saved-variant price or stock differences found. This validates the captured international assortment, not every mainland product.

stores.name: Rolife international store
stores.finding: The surprise-figure collection shows 28 items, while no direct-store offers are captured. BabyNanci Milk Tea has an exact product page describing six regular designs and one hidden design. DIY buildings and craft kits are outside this catalog.

stores.name: TOYZEROPLUS
stores.finding: The working address is toyzeroplus.com, without a hyphen. Its 322-record feed contains 41 broad-rule blind-box candidates. These are missing direct-store offers; some series may already appear through resellers. Non-blind art toys, bags and accessories are excluded.

stores.name: Hello Molynk
stores.finding: Product pages are readable at /product/, although the previous Shopify-style collector failed. Wishful Bite Cake is listed at USD 79.99 with two named options. Unigo has conflicting design counts in its own description, so its assortment count remains unverified. Store identity assertions are not an independent authorization check.

stores.name: Finding Unicorn international store
stores.finding: The configured direct-store URL could not be retrieved in this audit. Reseller listings do not establish that the direct shop works or that its full assortment is covered. No empty-store conclusion is justified.

stores.name: Kouhigh Toys
stores.finding: The store opens a password/maintenance page. Its 122 captured records remain historical; current product identity, prices and stock could not be rechecked. A reopening message is not proof that trading resumed.

stores.name: ToyBeta
stores.finding: 1,127 of 1,136 saved URLs matched; nine now return 404. Six new candidates include Rayan ROOM In My Heart and Peach Riot Sugar Mode. The Sweet Dreams Forecast page is correct despite its older Moon Gelato URL slug.

stores.name: DidaPop
stores.finding: 1,536 of 1,537 saved listing URLs matched; one Nommi preorder page returns 404. Two new figure candidates were found. Three clothing pages pass the loose blind-box keyword rule but remain excluded. One product can have multiple offers, so listing URLs differ from card counts.

stores.name: Pawmiga World
stores.finding: All 16 saved URLs matched. Six additional named Lisa/Kira squishy listings were found. The store also lists many maker products without the word squishy; a keyword-only importer cannot establish full assortment coverage.

stores.name: Iris Squishy
stores.finding: 85 of 86 saved URLs matched. The SmileGogo Lucky Cat page now returns 404. No differences were found in matched saved variants. Retailer authenticity and maker-authorization claims were not independently certified.

stores.name: RonRon Squishy
stores.finding: All 36 saved URLs matched the 36-record feed, with no saved-variant differences. Chocolate Afternoon Tea and Butter & Cocoa are shown sold out on the storefront; historical presence should not be read as current availability.

stores.name: ANTHILL shopNplay
stores.finding: The one saved Molynk offer matched. The broader store feed has 509 records and 83 additional keyword candidates, including imported characters. The current collector deliberately restricts this source to Molynk; this is not a complete shop assortment.

stores.name: Heartfelt Chinese-squishy specialist
stores.finding: All 278 saved listing URLs remain in the 336-link Chinese-squishy category crawl. The other 58 links need classification; some are mixed-product compilations or shopping services. Page prices localized to USD in this audit, so they were not compared with saved HKD prices.

stores.name: JOTOYS international store
stores.finding: All 36 saved URLs matched. One saved full-set option returned to stock. OYO Portable Bag Mini and KOKOSA Fruit Party need product review; the mixed Collector’s Bundle is excluded. The Best Sellers label is retailer curation without published unit volumes.

stores.name: Sonny Angel Japan official store
stores.finding: All 56 saved URLs matched the 104-record Japanese feed; three variant stock differences were found. Japanese names defeat the English keyword rule, so its zero candidate count is not a completeness finding. SMISKI and other Dreams products must retain their own identities.

stores.name: POP MART US product evidence
stores.finding: The official US Dip For Fun Squishy Charm page was read successfully. Its source identifies a US online release on 15 October 2026 and PU foam/PVC/acrylic/metal. This one evidence page does not constitute a complete POP MART direct-store assortment.
